protocol.order: case order rotated by round; engine order rotated by case/round and reversed on odd rounds; one page/context at a time
protocol.timing: Unmodified published runMethod/runGrid; fresh page per engine/sample; download and module evaluation excluded, GTPL JIT compilation inside mount included; DOM completion, validation and forced layout are the common fence.
protocol.heap: Separate pass. The sole readMemory call is replaced in a virtual module with CDP HeapProfiler.collectGarbage + Runtime.getHeapUsage. usedSize covers V8 JavaScript heap, not native DOM/RSS. Timings from the heap pass are not ranked. Published files are unchanged.

heapHook.replacement: memory = await readMemory(); -> memory = await globalThis.__benchmarkHeapRead();

protocol.fixtures: 500 rows/elements; list local edits: 1 and 50 rows, 9 iterations, fresh replacement before each edit, native reactive state (React immutable rows + memo). Full-array operations retained separately. if and each switch branch have 128 blocks; switch variants 8/32/64; grid from 16, 4 levels, step 16 at 100%, base seed 42 + level; 64 at 10%, seed 42.
protocol.latencyIndex: Six equally weighted DOM cases: for-500, if, styles, classes, attributes, forms. Within each case, mount and operations each have weight 1/2. List operations (update/append/remove/reverse/replace) and conditional operations (show/hide/revisit) are equally weighted within their half. Geometric mean of each median divided by the corresponding vanilla median. Switch memory and grid stress/FPS are reported separately, never mixed into this latency index.
